watches.name: Averau Ceramic Chrono “Amaranth”
watches.description: ARCHIVE 02 This piece is a one-of-a-kind watch. It takes shape during the exploration phase, where proportions, materials and details are tested and refined. Based on the Averau Ceramic 42 Chrono, it combines a matte black ceramic case with the TiFrame™ system in Grade 2 titanium, powered by the automatic Sellita SW510B-1 Elaboré calibre. For this unique piece, the main indices and hands receive a distinctive amaranth red accent, creating a precise visual tension against the deep matte surface of the dial. The result is a singular interpretation of the existing Averau Ceramic 42 Chronograph: familiar in its architecture, but instinctive, assertive and expressive in its presence on the wrist. Important: this piece is one of a kind. Only a single unit was produced.
